offering_description.value: Global alternative asset management firm that manages multi-asset-class portfolios and customized investment solutions in hedge funds, private equity, infrastructure, real estate and credit. Clients are institutional investors, such as pension funds and sovereign wealth funds, and high-net-worth individuals. It invests through funds of funds, co-investments and separately managed accounts.

primary_products.value: private equity funds; infrastructure funds; hedge fund portfolios; real estate funds; credit funds

primary_services.value: investment management; customized separate account solutions; investment advisory; co-investment programs; portfolio consulting

customer_segment.value: B2B: pension funds, sovereign wealth funds, endowments, foundations, insurers and financial institutions; B2C: high-net-worth individuals through private wealth channels

end_markets.value: institutional investing; private wealth management; alternative investments

revenue_model.value: commissions or management fees: management fees on assets under management and advisory assets; commissions or management fees: incentive fees and carried interest on investment performance
revenue_model.category: commissions or management fees; commissions or management fees

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: raises capital from investors and allocates it to managers and investments across alternative asset classes

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: in-house client teams serving institutional investors; partners / resellers: wealth management platforms and advisors distributing funds to private clients
